def find_path(graph, start, goal):
    path = [start]
    visited = set()
    while path:
        current_node = path.pop()
        if current_node == goal:
            return path
        if current_node in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(current_node)
        path.extend((node for node in graph[current_node] if node not in visited))
    return None
